pin.estimand: minted at filing time — no preregistration existed for this row
admissibility_gates: none declared — attempt minted at filing time

attempt.note: not a preregistration — record created retroactively so the row is joinable; mint-before-spend evidence does not exist for it

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.note_on_seed: none — token_delta is deterministic; no sampling or model inference
manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: fresh semantic pairs against the filed qualifier’s operative careful-English disclosure; each pair preserves task, responsible principal, illocutionary force, and the specific hard-cell meaning being compressed
manifest.arm_construction: eight previously unused hard cells, balanced four no-delegation and four one-hop-delegation-allowed; covers tools, advice, plural level-zero actors, retained authority, sibling delegates, accountability, authority limits, and delegate capability
manifest.aggregation: per-tokenizer mean Ainglish-minus-English token count over all eight pairs; reported value is the conservative least-favourable tokenizer mean; value_lo/value_hi are min/max tokenizer means

pairs.ainglish: req: verify the release checksum with the pinned local tool, no-delegation
pairs.english: req: verify the release checksum with the pinned local tool; do not assign any completion-bearing part to a different principal, though using that deterministic tool is permitted

pairs.ainglish: will: draft the incident finding after consulting counsel, no-delegation
pairs.english: will: draft the incident finding after consulting counsel; I will not assign any completion-bearing part to a different principal, but may ask counsel for advice

pairs.ainglish: req: Mira and Sol reconcile the shipment ledger, no-delegation
pairs.english: req: Mira and Sol must reconcile the shipment ledger themselves; their named pair may divide the work internally but must not assign a completion-bearing part outside that pair

pairs.ainglish: will: review the access request and perform the privileged approval, no-delegation
pairs.english: will: review the access request and perform the privileged approval; I will not assign any completion-bearing part to a different principal
req: classify the archive; you may assign parts to several immediate delegates, but none of those delegates may pass an assigned part to another principal

pairs.ainglish: will: assemble and publish the benchmark, one-hop-delegation-allowed
pairs.english: will: assemble and publish the benchmark; I may use immediate delegates who may not redelegate, and I remain accountable for integrating their work and completing the task

pairs.ainglish: req: prepare the payment batch, one-hop-delegation-allowed
pairs.english: req: prepare the payment batch; you may use immediate delegates who may not redelegate, but this permission grants no extra authority and all original constraints remain in force

pairs.ainglish: will: inspect the remote facility, one-hop-delegation-allowed
pairs.english: will: inspect the remote facility; I may use immediate delegates who may not redelegate, but the qualifier does not guarantee that any delegate has the required access or capability

manifest.method: Re-run with tiktoken 0.13.0: for each encoding and pair compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)); average within encoding; take the maximum encoding mean as value.
manifest.recertification_note: fresh hard-cell token-cost recertification; this tests compression only and does not substitute for the proposal’s required comprehension and fidelity panels
